next.reason: 1985 WRITE GR10: 'The END-WRITE phrase delimits the scope of the WRITE statement.' 2023 states it through the general scope-terminator rule (Table 12 pairs WRITE with END-WRITE): the terminator ends §2023:14.5.3.2 GR1 'the most-recently preceding unterminated statement having the statement-name for which that scope terminator is defined' and §2023:14.5.3.2 GR2 the statements nested in it. Same programs, same scope.
